test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: During which of the following seasons was the National Agricultural Insurance Scheme launched to protect the farmers against crop losses suffered on account of natural calamities such as droughts, floods, hailstorms, cyclones, pests and diseases?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rabi 1999-2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Agricultural Insurance Scheme (NAIS)** was launched during the **Rabi season of 1999-2000**.
 
• The main objective of this scheme was to provide **insurance coverage and financial support** to farmers in the event of failure of crops due to **natural calamities** such as droughts, floods, hailstorms, cyclones, pests, and diseases.
 
• The scheme was introduced by the **Government of India** to replace the earlier **Comprehensive Crop Insurance Scheme (CCIS)**.
 
• It is applicable to all crops, including **food crops, oilseeds, and commercial or horticultural crops.**
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Agricultural Insurance Company of India (AIC)** in coordination with the respective state governments.
 
• Premium rates are subsidized for small and marginal farmers, ensuring inclusivity for economically weaker farmers.
 
• NAIS is a **social security measure** aimed at reducing the financial burden on farmers in case of crop failures due to unforeseen circumstances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kharif 2001-2002**__

 __
 
• This option indicates a different agricultural season, but the **NAIS was not launched during this period**.
 
• The Kharif season primarily includes **monsoon-dependent crops**, such as rice, maize, and cotton, but it does not relate to the launch of NAIS.
 
 
 
• **Rabi 2005-2006**__
 __
 
• This option refers to a later season when the NAIS had already been launched and operational for several years.
 
• However, the scheme was introduced much earlier in **Rabi 1999-2000**.
 
 
 
• **Kharif 1998-1999**__
 
 
• This date precedes the actual launch of the scheme.
 
• The **NAIS was not operational** during this period, as it was officially introduced in the **Rabi 1999-2000** season.
